title: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC)
provider: Department of Higher and Technical Education
benefits: 50% to 100% tuition fee waiver depending on income level.

title: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna
provider: Department of Higher and Technical Education
benefits: Hostel allowance up to INR 30,000 per year for students studying out of their hometown.

title: Government of India Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
benefits: Full tuition fee waiver and maintenance allowance.

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
benefits: Full tuition fee waiver and maintenance allowance.

title: Post-Matric Scholarship to VJNT, OBC, and SBC Students
provider: VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department
benefits: Tuition fees, exam fees, and maintenance allowance.

title: State Minority Scholarship Part II (DHE)
benefits: Financial assistance of INR 5,000 for arts/commerce/science and higher for technical courses.

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for Persons with Disability
provider: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
benefits: Maintenance allowance, book grant, and reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees.

title: Pramod Mahajan Skill and Entrepreneurship Development Mission
benefits: Free skill training and certification, placement assistance.
